decision: Paper 2 proceeds as an engineering study using public data and computation only. No human annotation will be collected: the RFMiD annotation package and the Chaksu calibration package are not delivered; S1-S3 of amendment 2 and the annotation analyses of preregistration.json are not performed and will be reported as not performed.
status_at_decision: no annotation exists; no reference for RFMiD; the label-free selection record exists (results/fe/rfmid_supp/labelfree_selection_record.json)
retained_use: the label-free selection record is used only for an exploratory, ground-truth-free consistency check (agreement of the RFMiD A/C choice with the Chaksu choice); external ground-truth validation moves to RIGA (public, six ophthalmologists) under its own pre-registration
